data.name: Portable Ops 2
data.detailed_description:
Portable Ops 2 — EACH MISSION has a Consequence

Following the intense events of the original Portable Ops, Portable Ops 2 picks up the story of elite operatives in a world fractured by betrayal and rising conflict. The new campaign thrusts players back into high-stakes tactical missions where strategic squad management and loyalty are just as vital as stealth and firepower. As global tensions erupt and old alliances crumble, veterans and fresh recruits alike must navigate a web of deception, uncover hidden agendas, and fight to redefine what it means to be a soldier in an age of shifting loyalties. With deeper character arcs, expanded team-building mechanics, and richer narrative stakes, Portable Ops 2 builds on the legacy of its predecessor while pushing the saga into bold new territory.

PERMA DEATHS - OPERATORS DIE, NO RESPAWNS, NO SECOND LIVES - IF YOU DON'T EXTRACT ALIVE, THATS IT
STORY MODE - MORE THAN 9 LEVELS OF ACTION + CHARACTER AND BASE BUILDING
BASE BUILDING - CHOOSE BETWEEN BASES & ADJUST THE BASE TO YOUR TACTICS
OPERATOR GEAR - USE ITEMS WISELY IN ALL MISSIONS

HYPER REALISTIC GRAPHICS
FEAT. OUTLAW FPV BRINGING PLAYERS TO REAL LIFE MISSIONS

data.short_description: Every mission has consequences. PERMA DEATH – No respawns. Die in the field, you’re gone. STORY MODE – 9+ action levels with character and base progression. BASE BUILDING – Choose and customize your base to fit your tactics. OPERATOR GEAR – Use equipment wisely to survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100/AMD Ryzen 3 1200, FX4350 or greater
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 SUPER/AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated DirectX 11 compatible soundcard
